title: Text API gets another model and a cache
summary:
A small text-and-audio tooling day: Groq Qwen support, cached text responses, and a Python audio example.

text.pollinations.ai now supports Groq Qwen, while Cloudflare caching helps repeat text requests return with less waiting around.

The API docs now include a Python example for audio interaction with the OpenAI model, so developers have one less endpoint-shaped mystery to solve.
